Migration.Name: Add_M_Reservation_Product_Index
Migration.Comments: Add index on M_Reservation.M_Product_ID to speed up per-product reservation lookups (Available-to-Promise detail and the Update Storage process), avoiding a full sequential scan of the reservation ledger. by EdwinBetanc0urt.

Step.SQLStatement: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_m_reservation_m_product_id ON M_Reservation (M_Product_ID);
